description: Apache CXF Runtime Core is the core runtime module of the CXF web services framework, providing the Bus implementations (extension-based, Spring, Blueprint, and OSGi) together with the bus managers that wire CXF extensions, bindings, and transports. It also supplies the reflection-based service factory, WSDL 1.1 and XML catalog support, Source and StAX data bindings, security interceptors, and GZIP transport support used by the CXF frontends.
